name: johantor
description: Team-style software delivery for Claude Code: an orchestrated multi-agent crew for building features and paying down tech debt, a local board of every session, and brain, which learns from every session.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Team-style feature delivery for Claude Code: a captain agent plans the work and delegates each step to backend, frontend, test, and design specialists behind hook-enforced guardrails, with a consolidated review gate before anything ships. Also pays down tech debt one verified, gated batch at a time.

plugins.name: board
plugins.description: A local kanban board of every Claude Code session: what needs you, what is running, what you closed today. Hooks log each session's state, a small Node server on 127.0.0.1 shows it as cards, and a click copies the resume command. Crew runs show their subagents on the session's card.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Learns from every Claude Code session. Hooks record each session's prompts, failing tool calls, denied permissions, interrupts and token use to a local SQLite file, scrubbed. Reflection (off by default) drafts lessons from your corrections; loading (off by default) puts them in each session, scores them by holdout, retires the ones that do not help, and turns three on one tool into a skill. /brain:report shows the records.
